summary: Claude Code plugin that shows context usage, rate limits, active tools, running agents and todo progress in a status line under your input.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Claude HUD is a plugin for Claude Code that adds a heads-up display below the input box. It shows how much context you've used, your rate limits, which tools are active, which agents are running and how far through the todo list Claude is.
sixtySeconds.problem: During long Claude Code sessions it's hard to see how close you are to context or rate limits and what Claude is doing. The HUD keeps that visible at all times.
whoFor: People running long or multi-agent sessions
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an always-visible summary of session health with a guided setup.
requirements: Node.js 22.18 or later (the /hud command helps if yours is older)

overview: Inside Claude Code, add the marketplace, install the plugin, reload plugins and run /hud. You can also install from the terminal with the claude plugin commands.
/hud checks your setup and, after asking you, points your status line at the HUD.
Claude Code doesn't auto-update third-party plugins by default; turn on auto-update for this marketplace in /plugin. It is MIT licensed.
